annotation_provenance: Authored fresh for Milestone 11-G1, entirely self-authored synthetic sentences (no third-party job-posting text, no reuse of M11-D/M11-F private material -- M11-F's own real posting is used only as a local, already-inspected diagnostic trace in Phase 1, never copied into this file). schema_notes.expect_decline: true if extract_competency_qualifications_v2 must return a DeclinedExtraction; false if it must return a Qualification tuple
schema_notes.expect_reason: the DeclinedExtraction.reason expected when expect_decline is true, else null
schema_notes.expect_tag: the single expected competency_tag when expect_decline is false and the result is a single/AND-split Qualification with a normalized tag, else null
schema_notes.expect_sibling_tags: for genuine AND-of-distinct-areas cases: the full set of tags expected across the sibling Qualification tuple
schema_notes.expect_logical_composition: single | and | mixed_unsupported -- only meaningful when expect_decline is false
schema_notes.category: the Phase 2 category number (1-18) this control exercises
